scenario: Discussing weekend plans with a friend
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Irihererwa cyane kugirango ubwiranye iby’ubushakashatsi cyangwa iby’ubushakashatsi.
Nayoguswa kugirango ubwiranye iby’ubushakashatsi cyangwa kugirango ushushanye.
Irihererwa na 'to' kugirango ubwiranye ahantu cyangwa ibikorwa.
Ibyo biranga ubwoko bw’ibyo cyangwa ibikorwa.
Mu kino kigereranyo, ibyo biranga ubushakashatsi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation: Ushobora kuba ufite ubushakashatsi wo ku wa kiri?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think I want to go to the beach, but maybe it will be too crowded.
dialogue.translation: Ntekereza ko nshaka kugenda ku mazi, ariko byari kuva bizaba bifite abantu benshi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea! But do you have time to go with me?
dialogue.translation: Ikindi kiganiro! Ariko, ushobora kuba ufite igihe kugenda na jye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I have time because I finished my work early.
dialogue.translation: Yego, nifite igihe kubera ko narakanye igikorwa cyanjye nyuma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect! I think it will be a good weekend.
dialogue.translation: Ni nziza! Ntekereza ko bizaba ari kiri kiziza.

scenario: Returning a faulty item at a shop
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, narakuye telefoni iyi hano, ariko ntigukorera.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Mbabarira ku byerekeye ibyo. Wageze mute ubu warakuye?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Gusa mbere ya kabiri. Ndashaka impya, yo wowe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Gutura ibimenyetso ibi kandi ugirangirize. Nyuma yibyotoyi, nashobora kugura icyo kugaburira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Murakoze. Bityo nkubura telefoni ifite ibibazo, kandi nashobora gutura impya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Ni byo birimo. Kandi yo wowe, ushaka kugaburira bigeze, njuguze.

scenario: Booking a table at a restaurant by phone
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ibisobanuro byerekana ububiko cyangwa icyo kuri cyo.
Mu mubare w'ikiganza, ibisobanuro byerekana meza yatanzwe.
Ibisobanuro byerekana ububiko cyangwa icyo kuri cyo.
Ikorwa mu ibiro kugirira 'kuba na ububiko'.
Ibisobanuro byerekana 'bifite ububiko' mu mubare uwo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to book a table for tonight.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, ndasaba kugirira meza kuri iyi si.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. For how many people?
dialogue.translation: Yego. Kuri abantu benshi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For four people, please.
dialogue.translation: Kuri abantu bane, murakaza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have a free table at 8 o'clock. Is that okay?
dialogue.translation: Dufite meza ifite ububiko kuri 8 za none. Ni byiza?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll call back to confirm later.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ni byiza. Nzagirira kugirira gacumu kugirango ngambure.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have your name for the reservation?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Nshobora kuba na izina ryawe kuri ububiko?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name García.
dialogue.translation: Yego, muri izina García.

scenario: Describing symptoms at a pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I feel very bad since yesterday.
dialogue.translation: Ndagiye nkubwiye cyane tungeri hese.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What do you have?
dialogue.translation: Wifashije iki?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: My head hurts, and I still have a lot of pain.
dialogue.translation: Umuntwe wanjye ubara, nanone ndagiye nkubwiye cyane.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you have any other symptoms?
dialogue.translation: Wifashije ibindi by'ubwoba?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I also feel tired most of the day.
dialogue.translation: Yego, no nkubwiye kuba ntarenganye mu gihe cyose cy'umunsi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take this medicine while you are here, and you will feel better soon.
dialogue.translation: Nywa idahinyuka iri mu gihe uri hano, kandi uzagira neza bihari.

scenario: Talking about your hometown to a visitor
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa kugirango vugwa ahantu cyangwa umujyi.
Ikoreshwa kugirango vugwa buri kuri buri mu biro by'ishyano.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Welcome to my hometown! It's a small place, but I love it.
dialogue.translation: Murakaza neza mu rugo rwanjye! Ni ahantu kirekire, ariko niyifasha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks! Where do you live exactly?
dialogue.translation: Murakoze! Uri he uturuka neza?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I live near the old church. It's very beautiful.
dialogue.translation: Nturuka hafi y'igitero cyane. Ni nziza cyane.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! Is there a market every day?
dialogue.translation: Oh, ni byiza! Hari isoko buri munsi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, and I walk there every morning to buy fresh things.
dialogue.translation: Yego, kandi nitsa hanyuma buri made kugura ibintu byinshi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. Then we can go together tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Bitewe neza. Hanyuma turinda kuhaguruka?

scenario: Changing a reservation at a hotel
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bishobora kuba uburyo bw'urupapuro, ubw'igikombe, n.k.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to change my reservation for a different day.
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, nshaka guhindura uburyo bwange ku munsi wundi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want to come earlier or later?
dialogue.translation: Yego. Ushaka kugera kare cyangwa nyuma?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Later, please. Is a room available for next week?
dialogue.translation: Nyuma, nyamuneka. Mushobora kuba mfite urupapuro rw'icyuma kuri iyumwenda ry'icyuma?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me check. We have another room free after Monday.
dialogue.translation: Nibye ndebereye. Dufite urupapuro rwundi rwishyushye nyuma ya mbere y'icyumweru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I change my reservation to that day?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Nshobora guhindura uburyo bwange ku munsi uwo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but you must confirm before Friday.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ariko wabaye wemeza mbere y'icyumweru.

scenario: Asking for advice on what to buy
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Sustantivo incontable, no se usa en plural
Se usa en afirmaciones; en preguntas/negaciones se usa 'anything'
Se refiere al costo de un producto
Sustantivo incontable; se dice 'a piece of advice'
Se usa con objeto directo o con 'that'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to buy something for my brother, but I don't have much money.
dialogue.translation: Nshaka kugura ikinini kuri gukuri wanjye, ariko ntabwo nifite ikibanza kingana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What's the price range? Something cheap or expensive?
dialogue.translation: Ni ububiko buki? Ikinini ngombwa cyangwa bigombwa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheap, please. Can you recommend a good gift for a buyer like me?
dialogue.translation: Ngombwa, nyamuneka. Washobora kushingira igikuru kiiza kumununga nk'ujye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I advise you to choose a nice mug or a book.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Nshingiye kwihitamo igikombe giiza cyangwa igitabo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great! I'll take your advice and choose the mug.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza! Nzashimora umwirondoro wawe no hitamo igikombe.

scenario: Talking about past holidays
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you go anywhere last year?
dialogue.translation: Wagiye aho kure ikinya gihe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I went to the beach. The weather was really good there.
dialogue.translation: Yego, naje kuri ubwoko. Igihe byari by'ukuri nziza hari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Did you get time to relax?
dialogue.translation: Bitewe neza. Wahawe igihe kugumya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, because it was very quiet. I loved it.
dialogue.translation: Yego, kubera ko byari byumvikana cyane. Nabyifuzwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. Did you come back tired?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Wahagarutse wagomboye?

scenario: Discussing what you did last weekend
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.translation: humbuye, gutubuka (mu magambo nk’ ‘eat out’ = kurya humbuye)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! What did you do this weekend?
dialogue.translation: Muramase! Wakoze iki ku munsi w’umukorana?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I visited my grandparents and stayed at their house.
dialogue.translation: Naje kw’ababyeyi bange n’ukuguma mu nyumba yabo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice! Did you enjoy it?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza! Wagumanye neza?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we watched a movie together on Saturday.
dialogue.translation: Yego, twarabone ifilimu hamwe ku wa Gatano.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds great. Did you go out to eat?
dialogue.translation: Bishimwa neza. Mwakubukanye kurya humbuye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, because we cooked at home. It was very relaxing.
dialogue.translation: Oya, kubera twakuye kwita mu ruhu. Byari byagumye neza.

key_phrases.phrase: What did you do this weekend?

scenario: Planning a birthday party
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kugira ubwenge ku mutwe canke ku njera.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to plan the party for Ana's birthday. How many people should we invite?
dialogue.translation: Dutegereza gutegura umunsi w'ishyano w'Ana. Ni abantu bangana bangana twishyira?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I have an idea: let's invite about ten friends. When is the party going to be?
dialogue.translation: Nifuze igitekerezo: wishyire abagenzi bashize aha. Ryari umunsi w'ishyano uzaba ari?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: On Saturday afternoon. We also need a big cake for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Ku wa Gatano none. Dutegereza no igikeri kikinge kuri buri wese.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good. I can make the cake, and we can play a fun game outside.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Nshobora gukora igikeri, kandi dutanga umukino w'ishushanyo hagati.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect. Now we only need to buy the decorations.
dialogue.translation: Bitewe nka byiza. None dutegereza gukura ibyo bishushanyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great, we have a plan! When you go, remember to get some balloons too.
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza, duteguye! Ryari ukiza, remera kugura n'ibishushanyo by'amabere.

scenario: Asking about public transport routes
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Igikoresho cy'umutembere gikoreshwa na buri wese.
Bikanga umwanya w'icyo kiva cyangwa umwanya w'ububiko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how can I take a bus to the museum?
dialogue.translation: Niba wabaye, nshobora gute nkurikira basu kugeza ku musee?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take the number 5 bus from the stop here, and then get off at the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Kurikira basu y'umubare 5 mu parada hano, hanyuma ukaguruka ku parada yicyakurikiye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it far from here?
dialogue.translation: Mfite ikirefu mu kuba hano?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's not far. After you get off, walk left for two minutes, and the museum is on your right.
dialogue.translation: Oya, ntikirefu. Nyuma yoko ukaguruka, jana ibumoso uminota ibiri, kandi musee iri ibumenyi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, so I take the bus and then walk a little. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza, bityo nkurikira basu hanyuma nkoze gutembamo bigeze. Urakoze!

scenario: Talking about your job to someone new
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ikorwa kigaragaza umwanya w’ikorwa cyangwa igikorwa wako.
Igice cy’igihe; bihishurwa mu byatanze kugirango ubusabe ubw’igihe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm Mark. What do you do?
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse! Nda Mark. Ukoze iki?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I work at a small company. My job is interesting, but sometimes it's hard.
dialogue.translation: Nkoranya mu ikigo kiri hafi. Ikibazo cyanjye ni cyo kugirira, ahubwo bimwe by’igihe ni bigaragara.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. What are your hours?
dialogue.translation: Nibona. Ni igihe kingana iki?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I start at nine and finish at five. I often work late on Fridays.
dialogue.translation: Ntangira mu kumi n’ebyiri kandi ntangiza mu gate. Akenshi nkoranya kugeza mu gitondo ku wa mbere y’icyumweru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's not too bad. Tell me more about your company.
dialogue.translation: Nta kindi kibi. Nshyigikireho ku byerekeye ikigo cyawe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. We make software for schools. It's a good place to work.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Dufitiye amashini yo mu mashinga. Ni ubwoko bwiza bwo kugirira.

key_phrases.phrase: I start at nine and finish at five.
key_phrases.translation: Ntangira mu kumi n’ebyiri kandi ntangiza mu gate.

scenario: Describing your home and neighborhood
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Urugenzamenyo rwa ibati nini cyangwa amazu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Where do you live?
dialogue.translation: Uri aho ubuhoro bwakwiye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I live in a small building on the fifth floor. It's very quiet here.
dialogue.translation: Nzagiye mu isuzu ciniri ku rubuga rw'ibiri. Ni hagati cyane hano.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Is there a park near your street?
dialogue.translation: Bitewe neza. Hari umupaka mu kuri y'umujyi wawe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, there's a big park just two blocks away. But it's always crowded on weekends.
dialogue.translation: Yego, hari umupaka mukuru mu kuri y'ibice bibiri. Ari cyangwa ntabwo bifite abantu benshi ku wa mbere.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My apartment is small too, but it's near a quiet street.
dialogue.translation: Nibwo njye. Amazu yanjye ari ciniri, ari cyangwa ntabwo bifite abantu benshi mu kuri y'umujyi w'hagati.

scenario: Making plans for the next day
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Niyo igenzura no kuwa ijambo: 'a call'.
Igihe kinini, ariko ntibiri mu rutonde rw'ibiganzwe.
Naho ari mu rutonde rw'ibiganzwe, ni cyo kwinjirira mu biganiro; birahindwa mu biganiro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to do in the morning tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Wishaka kugira iki igitina ejo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe we can meet at the usual place before 9?
dialogue.translation: Nta niba. Ese tuba dukwiye kubana mu rutoje mbere y'asa ku 9?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's early for me, but I can call you later to confirm.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo ni kare kuri jewe, ariko nashobora kugirira nyuma yaho kugirango ndakemere.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Okay, but don't call too late because I go to sleep early.
dialogue.translation: Biza, ariko ntukagirire kure kandi kubera ntiyimba kare.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll call before 8. Then we can have a good day.
dialogue.translation: Nziza, ndakagirira mbere y'isa ku 8. Nyuma yaho tuba dukwiye kugira umunsi mwiza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm sure it will be a nice day.
dialogue.translation: Ni mwiza. Nziza ko izaba umunsi mwiza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room. The TV doesn't turn on.
dialogue.translation: Mbabarira, nifite ibikorwa mu rugo rwange. Televezi ntigucura.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it completely off?
dialogue.translation: Mbabaje kkubera ibyo mwarabwiye. Ese byahuye neza?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried, but it doesn't work. I really don't understand why.
dialogue.translation: Yego, narateye, arikiko ntibikora. Ntibura kubura neza kuki.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe there is a wrong connection. Let me check. I'll make it work soon.
dialogue.translation: Byari kuba hari ikibazo mu gucura. Njugutere. Nzazibikoraho nyuma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. I haven't watched anything yet, so I hope you can fix it now.
dialogue.translation: Murakoze. Ntanjye ntabwo nabonye ikintu, bityo ntekereza ko muzabigera kunzibikora.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll check it right away.
dialogue.translation: Yego. Mbabaje kkubera ibyo mwarabwiye. Nzazibikora nyuma.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Naribwire ifilm nshya kare. Byari nziza cyane!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: Oya ni by'ukuri? Ni inkuru ya iki?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Ni inkuru ya umuntu uvuye mu gihe kirekire. Ariko ikigereranyo ni cyiza cyane.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Bishimwa ineza. Nsomye gusa igitabo, si ifilm.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Nibwira ko ifilm ni nziza kurushaho igitabo. Ariko hanyuma nta nsomye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: Nyuma y'ukugera kw'ibyamirwa yanjye, nzayireba. Urakoze kuri ubushakashatsi!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange

scenario: At a job interview (basic)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: bifuzwa ku burimyi gushakisha umwirondoro cyangwa ubukene

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse. Nfite ibibazo byinshi kugirango ubifunze. Ku mbanza, kubera iki ushaka kuri kuri?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Ndashaka kuri kuri gushakisha abantu, kandi nfite ubumenyi mu kugabanya abakiri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Nibona. No, ushobora kugira urugo mu mbere n'ikwa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Yego, byakwiye. Nshobora kugira urugo ku mbere n'ikwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Ni byiza. Ryari ushobora gucika?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Nshobora gucika kuri ruri kubera ko gusaba gutanga amakuru mu murimo wanjye w'ubushake.

Birashishwa mu majuro y'omukanda n'inyama zifuzwa canke zifite ibiherero
Ijambo ryumunyana kuri ikintu canke umutwe
Mu mutwe uwu bishobora kubwira 'no' ku mwishirwa wa majuro

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Ushaka kurya iki ku mbere?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Ndakunda paste, ahubwo ntidakunda ikintu kinini uno uwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Dufite birindwi n'imbwa n'ibiryo by'imbuto mu fridgi. Ibyo birashobora kuba neza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Ibyo bitangwa neza. Ariko by'ukuri ndasaba ikintu kifite ubushyuha bwa hejuru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Ese tubanze kugorora ibiryo by'imbuto n'uburo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ni idea neza. Bityo turashobora kurya hamwe, no nashobora kugutegura no kugura.

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bifashwa kugirango ubaze ubufasha buri kuri k'ububiko.
Igikorwa cy'amavomo kugirango ubaze cyangwa ugabe ubufasha.
Bifashwa kugirango ubyerekeze ububiko cyangwa igikorwa.
Bifashwa kugirango ubyerekeze ububiko cyangwa igikorwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Wowe ushobora kundfasha? Ndashaka gukoresha ordanateur yanjye, ariko ekura ni iruhije.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Yego. Njugure. Wahise wagirawako ku kinyota kineza?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Yego, narakoze. Ahubwo ntigukorana. Byari byaba byagoye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Tugirane ubushake bigeze. Hafi n'igihe gikorana nyuma y'amasegonda yiteze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Barya, nzaza kugira ubwoba. Ariko, kubera ko ari k'ubushishozi, ndasaba kuri bwo ubu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Nibona. Njugure ndebereze ikinyota cy'amashusho. Ah, hano! Ubwo gukorana!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mu gihugu cy'Amerika bifashishwa; mu Bwongereza bifashishwa 'flat'.
Bifashishwa kuri ibintu cyangwa indango zishoboye gutegwa.
Igihe; bifashishwa kugera ubuhamya bwa kugura bwa kwezi.
Nayo ibigirwa 'suelo', ariko hano ni igare mu ishuri.
Kugera ubwokohebu bwa gihe cyangwa indango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Mwaramutse, nashaka kugura iduchanwa. Mbese ishoboye gutegwa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Yego, ishoboye gutegwa. Kugura ni ama dollar 800 kuri kwezi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Ese ikorana kigushyiramo amazi na gucungwa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Oya, kigushyiramo amazi gusa. Gucungwa ni gikurwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: N'igare ni iri he? Mbese iri hasi y'ishushanyo ry'ishushanyo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Iri ku gare rwa gatatu, n'iri hasi y'ishushanyo ry'ishushanyo ry'ishushanyo. Byari kuva ushobora kubisanga.
